title: Prime-power annihilation of a square
statement: Let p be prime and let a,j be natural numbers with j < a. Suppose z ∈ ZMod(p^a) satisfies p^j ∣ z.val and p^(j+1) ∤ z.val. For every natural n, (n : ZMod(p^a))z² = 0 if and only if p^(a−2j) ∣ n, where subtraction in the exponent is truncated natural subtraction.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → j < a → ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ a), p ^ j ∣ z.val → ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val → ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z ^ 2 = 0 ↔ p ^ (a - 2 * j) ∣ n)
